Take charge of site productivity improvement, labor standardization, production line balancing, lean system transformation, manufacturing cost reduction, and end-to-end continuous improvement for tier 1 manufacturing factories. Collaborate closely with factory management, production, quality, technical teams and regional headquarters to achieve core IE KPIs, drive operational excellence, and replicate standardized best practices across all supplier production sites. Key Responsibilities 1. Team Leadership & Management Lead, coach and develop a team of IE engineers and specialists, including setting team and individual performance objectives, conducting regular performance reviews, and recruiting and upgrading internal IE talents. Build systematic IE capability within cooperative factories, provide professional training for factory IE staff and production supervisors on time study, MOST work measurement, production line balancing, lean manufacturing tools and standardized operation procedures. 2. Labor Standard & Productivity Management Establish, verify and maintain accurate Standard Minute Values (SMV) and labor standard specifications for footwear production processes, including cutting, upper sewing, lasting, assembly and finishing. Carry out time and motion study, workstation layout optimization, manpower allocation adjustment and production line balancing for new product styles and existing mass production lines. Monitor core operational indicators including line efficiency, OEE and labor productivity, track unit production cost, identify operational gaps, and formulate and implement targeted improvement plans. 3. Continuous Improvement & Lean Projects Lead full-cycle continuous improvement and lean manufacturing projects, covering waste elimination, 5S management, Kaizen improvement, SMED quick changeover, TPM total productive maintenance, production bottleneck elimination, and reduction of rework and equipment idle time. Build and manage project pipelines, track project ROI, manufacturing cost savings and productivity improvement data, and submit monthly performance reports and business value analysis to regional management teams. Optimize factory overall layout and on-site material flow, effectively reduce work-in-progress inventory and production lead time. 4. Cross-functional & Supplier Collaboration Serve as the core IE technical lead for tier 1 manufacturing suppliers in Northern Vietnam and surrounding industrial zones. Cooperate with product development, quality control, sourcing and production planning teams in product development, pre-production verification, pilot production and formal mass production stages. Support new supplier factory onboarding, production capacity evaluation and IE system standard audit for new and existing cooperative factories. Timely report and escalate operational risks, productivity deficiencies and capacity constraint issues to regional management. 5. Reporting, KPI & Standardization Establish IE data dashboards and monthly performance reports, covering production efficiency, SMV compliance rate, labor cost, project cost savings and factory lean maturity assessment. Promote unified global IE management methods, standard templates and technical tools in local manufacturing bases, and align on-site operation practices with corporate operational excellence standards. Participate in green manufacturing and sustainable production initiatives to reduce production energy consumption and material waste. Requirements & Qualifications 1. Education Bachelor’s degree in Industrial Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, Footwear & Textile Engineering or other related engineering disciplines. 2. Professional Experience Minimum 7 years of industrial engineering working experience in footwear manufacturing industry, including at least 3 years of team management experience as IE Manager or Senior IE Lead. Profound practical knowledge of full footwear production procedures, including cutting, upper sewing, lasting, assembly and finishing processes. Proven successful experience in leading lean transformation and continuous improvement projects, with verifiable achievements in labor cost reduction and production efficiency improvement. Familiar with international brand supplier management standards, with rich experience in serving international footwear brand customers. Proficient in SMV formulation, time & motion study, MOST work measurement system, line balancing and footwear production cost accounting. 3. Technical & Soft Skills Fluent in oral and written English, capable of smooth cross-region business communication and report presentation. Strong data analysis capabilities, proficient in advanced Excel functions (Pivot Table, VLOOKUP, Power Query) and independent production KPI dashboard design. Excellent root cause analysis, on-site problem-solving, project management and cross-department stakeholder coordination skills. Able to travel to supplier factories in Northern Vietnam on a regular basis. Practical and down-to-earth working attitude, capable of rooting in production workshops and driving operational reform and team improvement. Lean Six Sigma Green Belt / Black Belt certification is a strong plus. 4. Core Competencies Result-oriented, sensitive to manufacturing cost and efficiency, with strong work ownership and responsibility. Good cross-cultural collaboration ability, capable of unifying factory teams to achieve overall operational KPIs. High professional integrity, familiar with international manufacturing factory audit and compliance management requirements.

review_candidates.description: We are seeking an experienced investment professional to join our global manager research team. You will lead and support in-depth due diligence, assessment, and ongoing monitoring across active and passive investment strategies; and deliver independent, well-structured recommendations and reporting to support decision-making across our institutional and wealth platforms. The level of responsibility and seniority will be calibrated based on the candidate’s experience and proven track record. Position Responsibilities Conduct in-depth, ongoing quantitative and qualitative research, on investment strategies and portfolio managers across asset classes, including portfolio manager meetings to assess philosophy, process, team, performance, and risk to ensure success of strategies being covered; identify issues early and drive remediation. Apply a consistent approach to identify return/ risk drivers, develop value propositions, and produce decision-ready recommendations, enhance processes to improve efficiency, quality and productivity. Strengthen the Global Manager Research team’s center of expertise through adding value to the Global Wealth and Asset Management businesses with insights on investment manager analysis; foster strong partnership with key stakeholders across the company Serve as the subject matter expert for the local and regional investment platforms in Asia; actively engage in boards and committees to advise product selection, conduct platform analysis, and support business growth and strategic initiatives. Lead/support ad-hoc projects Required Qualifications 5+ years of experience in investment manager / mutual fund research, due diligence, and manager selection. strong grasp of global markets, asset classes, and the asset management industry (experience on multi-manager, endowment, sovereign, buy-side, or major consultant platforms is highly relevant). Detail orientation with solid analytical and writing skills; ability to synthesize complex findings into clear, actionable recommendations with a robust, consistent framework Ownership and accountability: prioritize, multi-task, and deliver end-to-end work independently while collaborating inclusively with global, cross-disciplinary stakeholders Growth mindset and proactivity: open to feedback, commits to resolve problems end-to-end, stewardship orientation, and motivation to do what is right Excellent communication and stakeholder management; confident presenting to diverse audiences and maintaining well-reasoned, evidence-based views through rigorous discussion Verbal and written proficiency in English and Mandarin and/or Cantonese Knowledge of wealth, retirement or investment-linked insurance scheme platforms across Asia preferred Proficient with Morningstar Direct, Lipper, Bloomberg and other research packages Post graduate degree, CFA/CAIA preferred When You Join Our Team We’ll empower you to learn and grow the career you want. We’ll recognize and support you in a flexible environment where well-being and inclusion are more than just words. As part of our global team, we’ll support you in shaping the future you want to see. review_candidates.title: Real Time Analyst
review_candidates.description: Company Description IDS is a records and data management company focused on providing practical, cost-effective alternatives to traditional records management and archiving solutions. The organization helps clients gain complete control over the information they create, process, preserve, and dispose of, turning documents from paper, email, or electronic files into digital assets. These digital assets are designed to power streamlined, secure, and efficient business processes. In a world where employees may work from any location and at any time, IDS supports teams in staying aligned and working from a shared, accurate information base. Role Description The Real Time Analyst is a full-time, on-site role based in Cairo, Egypt. This role is responsible for monitoring daily workforce activities, tracking service levels, and ensuring staffing aligns with call and workload volumes in real time. The Real Time Analyst will update schedules, manage intraday adjustments, and communicate changes to relevant teams to maintain operational efficiency and performance targets. Daily tasks include analyzing performance metrics, identifying trends or issues, escalating risks, and coordinating with team leaders and workforce planners to optimize resource utilization. The role also involves preparing concise reports and recommendations to support decision-making and continuous improvement across operations. Qualifications Candidates should possess strong Analytical Skills to interpret data, monitor performance trends, and identify operational risks or opportunities. Candidates should possess Workforce Management and eWFM skills to manage schedules, service levels, and intraday staffing adjustments using workforce management tools. Candidates should possess Workforce Planning skills to support forecasting, capacity planning, and long-term staffing strategies. Candidates should possess effective Communication skills to coordinate with operations teams, share updates clearly, and escalate issues promptly. Relevant experience in contact center or operations environments, particularly in real-time or workforce management functions, is beneficial. Proficiency in Excel and reporting tools, with attention to detail and accuracy in data handling, is preferred. Ability to work in a fast-paced environment, prioritize tasks, and make timely decisions under pressure. A bachelor’s degree in Business, Statistics, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience, is advantageous.
